description: This file contains partial class definitions related to AdoNet-based grain directory options, configuration validation, and extension methods for setting up AdoNet grain directory in an Orleans silo. It includes configuration options, a validator class, and extension methods for integration.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
classes.description: A configuration validator class for AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for AdoNet grain directory, including connection string and invariant.

methods.name: AdoNetGrainDirectoryOptionsValidator
methods.description: Constructor for the options validator class.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Method to validate the options configuration.

methods.name: AddAdoNetGrainDirectory
methods.description: Extension method to add AdoNet grain directory to the silo builder with options configuration.

methods.name: UseAdoNetGrainDirectoryAsDefault
methods.description: Extension method to set AdoNet grain directory as default for the silo builder.
